administrativeResidents.joinPolicy: Exact 10-digit sourceCode only: province=canonicalCode+8 zeros; district=canonicalCode+5 zeros; neighborhood=canonicalCode+2 zeros. Names are not fuzzy matched. City aggregates and subordinate wards both remain separate source rows. Never assign an administrative resident total to a commercial trade area.
administrativeResidents.definition: 주민등록 전체: 거주자·거주불명자·재외국민 포함, 외국인 제외. 월말 기준. 실제 거주·방문·구매 고객 수와 다릅니다.

limitations: No live foot traffic or verified current opening status.
Food business records are not deduplicated physical outlets.
Administrative resident populations are not trade-area visitors.
Source administrative region codes and coordinate precision are preserved.
